summary: The embedded half of 0099: an extended host names an embedded subkind as its child, so a nested embedded member (Cascade's invariant) can be extended
acceptance: extend over an embedded base composes under an extended host; its members are checked as the subkind, and the subkind stays in the kinds map
tests: extend accepts an embedded base named by an extended host
an embedded member under an extended host is checked against the subkind's fields
notes: The nested-file half shipped (a55ab7e4). The build note: embedded composition keys members by the host's templates name, and an embedded kind takes a kind-fact row only with guidance/cite/leaves, so the subkind could fall out of the kinds map.
